top_band: tiled roof slopes from row 1 to row 43 (and central gable roof down to row 74)
evidence: The building clearly shows a large foreshortened tiled roof from row 1 to 43 above the vertical timber-framed walls (rows 44-74 on the wings, down to 106 on the central projection), with dark eave overhangs and recessed doors/windows.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul references, the candidate has been posterized/simplified to only 3 brown/tan shades plus a near-black outline. The plaster walls are completely flat single-color fills lacking the speckle texture of the reference, and the roof tiles and wood doors have lost their rich multi-step shading.
